name: Faraday Copper Corp.
summary: Faraday Copper Corp., a resource exploration stage company, engages in the acquisition, exploration, and development of mineral properties in the United States. The company holds 100% interest in the Copper Creek project consisting of 81 square kilometers of private land, patented and un-patented mining claims, and state prospecting permits located in Pinal County, Arizona. It also holds 100% interest in the Contact Copper Project comprising 155 patented claims covering an area of approximately 11 square kilometers, and 294 unpatented claims that cover an area of approximately 19 square kilometers situated in Elko County, Nevada.
